definitions.explanation: A person who fishes, especially as a hobby or sport. Distinct from a commercial fisherman; refers specifically to someone engaged in {釣|つ}り (rod-and-line fishing as recreation).

examples.japanese: ⟦{川辺|かわべ}→川辺：20224_kawabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{釣|つ}り{人|びと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧かいた。
examples.english: There were several anglers by the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{釣|つ}り{人|びと}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Anglers have been lined up along the breakwater since early morning.
A skilled angler reads the tides and chooses fishing spots accordingly.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧ (fishing) + {人|びと} (person). The reading of ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ shifts to び⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ in this compound (rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{人|びと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: anglers gather
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{釣|つ}り{人|びと}: a skilled angler
- {釣|つ}り{人|びと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: figure(s) of anglers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {釣|つ}り{師|し}: angler — emphasizes skill or seriousness; used for enthusiasts
- ⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧: fisherman — professional, commercial fisherman, not recreational
- {太公望|たいこうぼう}: angler (literary/humorous) — refers to a person devoted to fishing as a pastime
